rca_of_issue: RCA: distributor-isolation refactor added `distributor_id` as a required 4th parameter of _build_stops in server.py, and updated save_route to pass it, but optimize_route (line 1438) was overlooked and continued to call with 3 args, causing TypeError → 500 Internal Server Error whenever an agent (or anyone) hit /api/routes/{rid}/optimize. Reproduction: POST /api/routes/{rid}/optimize with any body → 500. Mitigation: pass r['distributor_id'] as the 4th argument. Verified by iter3 TestE_Routes.test_optimize_route_agent (200) and test_optimize_route_owner_forbidden (now 200, per existing code's permissive owner path).
